blocks.text: Titanium Industries | Build Plates for Additive Manufacturing

Metal additive manufacturing build plates are essential components in the realm of 3D printing, serving as the fundamental base for the fabrication of intricate and exact metal components. These plates, typically crafted from premium materials such as titanium and nickel, exhibit exceptional resilience and heat resilience. Their ability to be tailored to specific thicknesses and their optimized surface attributes make them ideal for ensuring superior adhesion and precise dimensional fidelity throughout the printing journey. Moreover, these build plates facilitate efficient heat dissipation and effectively mitigate distortion, guaranteeing the production of top-notch, dependable, and economically viable metal parts.

At Titanium Industries, we pride ourselves on offering a wide range of metal additive manufacturing build plates that meet the highest industry standards. Our build plates are engineered with meticulous attention to detail, ensuring superior performance and reliability. Whether you’re printing small intricate components or large-scale industrial parts, our build plates provide the stability and precision required for exceptional print quality.
T.I.´s superior additive manufacturing build plates
Available in any customized thickness (made to order)
Unique mechanical properties significantly decreasing the risk of distortion of the part from the platform
Thermal stability of the plate assured
Perfect overall performance especially when printing bigger parts
Longer lifespan compared to conventionally produced build plates

In conclusion, metal additive manufacturing build plates are the foundation for achieving outstanding results in 3D printing. Their exceptional resilience, customized thicknesses, optimized surface attributes, and efficient heat dissipation capabilities ensure superior adhesion, dimensional fidelity, and part quality. With Titanium Industries as your trusted partner, you can leverage the power of metal additive manufacturing to unlock new possibilities in product design, innovation, and manufacturing efficiency. Contact us today to discover how our metal additive manufacturing build plates can elevate your 3D printing capabilities.
